QuestInfo.name: Luke the Security Guy's Wish to Travel
QuestInfo.0: I hear that #b#p226##k the Security Guy made up his mind about something...
QuestInfo.1: I met with #p226# at the entrance of the dungeon again. The Snake Drink from back then was completely gone... because he and his mom drank it all... Ah, well. #p226# said he was over the boring life of a security guard and has decided to go on an adventure. To make a glove fit for the journey, #p504# of #m10004000# is asking for #b1 #t4031033##k, #b10 #t4010105#s#k, #b30 #t4000036#s#k, #b20 #t4000050#s#k, and #b20 #t4003000#s#k! He wants me to gather them for him... The fairies of #m10002000# might know something about the #t4031033#.
QuestInfo.2: I brought #p226# the materials he needed to make the gloves and received his treasured heirloom helmet, #b#t1002165##k, in return. It felt like I got the short end of the deal... but since it's a family heirloom, passed down for generations, I couldn't really complain...

0.0: Hey! You're the one that helped me make a tasty Snake Drink for my mom! I'm sorry to say this, but... my mom and I drank it all... hehe... Anyway, you look much stronger than before! Maybe you could even surpass me one day... Well, that's not going to happen, hahahaha...
0.1: Okay, I think you can do it since you've gotten much stronger since then...  I've actually been thinking about going on a journey somewhere... I'm getting tired of being the security guy here... I'm trying to make solid equipment for myself to do that, so I visited #p504# in #m10004000#, and... he wants me to get some RIDICULOUS materials for it!!! Those are so rare to begin with...
0.2: I'm trying to be a warrior, and um... can you get me the materials #p504# asked for? I tried, but it's too hard for me... Don't worry, I'll reward you well for your work. What do you think? Isn't it good for both of us?

yes.0: Yes! Actually, I really wanted to make a nice pair of gloves... and to make it, I need #b1 #t4031033##k, #b10 #t4010105#s#k, #b30 #t4000036#s#k, #b20 #t4000050#s#k, and #b20 #t4003000#s#k. Oh, the fairies might know about #b#t4031033##k. All right, I'm counting on you! If you get me the materials, I'll definitely give you something nice in return.

no.0: You must be really busy right now. If you ever have spare time, please come back and do me that favor! It's very important to me!

1.0: Oh my goodness, I can't believe you got everything! Sweet! If I get this to #p504#... wow, it's going to be one incredible glove... Oh yeah, I'll give you something good for doing me a favor. This helmet has been passed down in my family for generations, so please take good care of it.

yes.0: You got the #b#t1002165##k, right? Thanks for your hard work. It'll definitely help you on your journey, so use it well! Well then, time to go make these gloves...

item.0: You haven't gotten all the materials needed for the gloves yet? Get me #b1 #t4031033##k, #b10 #t4010105#s#k, #b30 #t4000036#s#k, #b20 #t4000050#s#k, and #b20 #t4003000#s#k! The fairies may know something about #b#t4031033##k. Keep working!
